G2190.d: from a primary (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan):--enemy, foe.

G2435.d: neuter of a derivative of ἱλάσκομαι; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.

G2492.d: of Hebrew origin (אִיּוֹב); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch:--Job.

G2311.d: from θεμέλιος; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.

G2457.d: of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion:--Julius.

G2345.d: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.

G2314.d: from θεός and μάχομαι; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.

G2014.d: from ἐπί and φαίνω; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known:--appear, give light.

G2288.d: from θνήσκω; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be…) death.

G2308.d: from θέλω; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.

G2306.d: from θεῖον and 1491; sulphur-like, i.e. sulphurous:--brimstone.

G2263.d: perhaps by transposition from ἔρημος (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.

G2355.d: from the base of θροέω; wailing:--lamentation.

G2340.d: from θήρα; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.

G2113.d: from εὐθύς and δρόμος; to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct:--(come) with a straight course.

G2412.d: from ἱερός and the same as πρέπω; reverent:--as becometh holiness.

G2164.d: from εὖ and φορέω; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth abundantly.

G2430.d: perhaps from εἰκών; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor:--Iconium.

G2141.d: from a compound of ἑτοιμάζω and the base of πορεία; (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means:--ability.

G2404.d: from ἱερός and πόλις; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor:--Hierapolis.

G2436.d: perhaps from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι; cheerful (as attractive), i.e. propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it:--be it far, merciful.

G2478.d: from ἰσχύς; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

G2332.d: from (a Thessalian) and νίκη; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor:--Thessalonica.

G2147.d: a prolonged form of a primary , which (together with another cognate form) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive, see.

G2262.d: of Hebrew origin (עֵר); Er, an Israelite:--Er.

G2042.d: from a presumed prolonged form of ἔρις; to stimulate (especially to anger):--provoke.

G2057.d: probably from Ἑρμῆς; Hermas, a Christian:--Hermas.

G2496.d: of Hebrew origin (יוֹרָם); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.

G2438.d: perhaps from the same as ἅμα; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge):--latchet, thong.

G2373.d: from θυμός; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.

G2196.d: of Hebrew origin (זֶרַח); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara.

G2401.d: of Hebrew origin (אֱדֹם); Idumæa (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine:--Idumæa.

G2032.d: from ἐπί and οὐρανός; above the sky:--celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

G2044.d: of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out:--utter.

G2108.d: from εὐεργέτης; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good deed done.

G2063.d: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with θάλασσα) the Red Sea:--red.

G2013.d: from ἐπί and τυγχάνω; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain:--obtain.

G2034.d: adverb from ἑπτά; seven times:--seven times.

G2236.d: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as ἡδέως; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.

G2479.d: from a derivative of (force; compare , a form of ἔχω); forcefulness (literally or figuratively):--ability, might(-ily), power, strength.

G2422.d: of Hebrew origin (יִפְתָּח); Jephthaë (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite:--Jephthah.

G2291.d: of Hebrew origin (תֶּרַח); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.

G2137.d: from a compound of εὖ and ὁδός; to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs:--(have a) prosper(-ous journey).
r: i might have a prosperous journey

G2171.d: from εὔχομαι; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation:--prayer, vow.

G2402.d: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat); perspiration:--sweat.

G2193.d: of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).

G2451.d: from Ἰουδαῖος; Judaïc, i.e. resembling a Judæan:--Jewish.

G2219.d: probably from ζέω; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.

G2204.d: a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.

G2022.d: from ἐπί and (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.

G2112.d: adverb from εὐθύς; directly, i.e. at once or soon:--anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

G2089.d: perhaps akin to ἔτος; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.

G2330.d: from a primary (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.

G2329.d: from the base of θέρος; warmth:--heat.

G2030.d: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a looker-on:--eye-witness.

G2178.d: from ἐπί and ἅπαξ; upon one occasion (only):--(at) once (for all).

G2099.d: from εὐαγγελίζω; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.

G2049.d: from ἔρημος; to lay waste (literally or figuratively):--(bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.

G2297.d: from θαῦμα; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.

G2383.d: of Hebrew origin (יָאִיר); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.

G2476.d: a prolonged form of a primary (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively):--abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare τίθημι.

G2375.d: from θύρα; a large shield (as door-shaped):--shield.

G2352.d: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare ῥήγνυμι.

G2040.d: from ἔργον; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher:--labourer, worker(-men).

G2243.d: of Hebrew origin (אֵלִיָּה); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.

G2186.d: from ἐπί and ἵστημι; to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal); --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

G2064.d: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) , or (active) , which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.

G2065.d: apparently from ἐρέω (compare ἐρευνάω); to interrogate; by implication, to request:--ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare πυνθάνομαι.

G2379.d: from a derivative of θυσία; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.

G2347.d: from θλίβω; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

G2210.d: from ζημία; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.
r: i have suffered the loss of

G2045.d: apparently from ἐρέω (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate:--search.

G2195.d: of Hebrew origin (compare זַכַּי); Zacchæus, an Israelite:--Zacchæus.

G2465.d: from ἴσος and ἄγγελος; like an angel, i.e. angelic:--equal unto the angels.

G2126.d: from εὖ and λαμβάνω; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious):--devout.

G2182.d: from a compound of ἐπί and εὑρίσκω; a discoverer, i.e. contriver:--inventor.

G2136.d: from the same as εὐοδόω; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman:--Euodias.

G2335.d: from the same as θεωρέω; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.

G2272.d: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of ἑδραῖος and perhaps ἔχω; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.

G2418.d: from a compound of ἱερόν and the base of ἔργον; to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively):--minister.

G2419.d: of Hebrew origin (יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare Ἱεροσόλυμα.

G2423.d: of Hebrew origin (יְכׇנְיָה); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite:--Jechonias.

G2143.d: from a compound of εὖ and πρέπω; good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness:--grace.

G2387.d: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.

G2495.d: of Hebrew origin (יוֹנָה); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites:--Jonas.

G2123.d: comparative of a compound of εὖ and κόπος; better for toil, i.e. more facile:--easier.

G2072.d: from εἰς and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a mirror (for looking into):--glass. Compare κατοπτρίζομαι.

G2060.d: perhaps from ἐρέω; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.

G2377.d: from θύρα and (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door, porter.

G2385.d: the same as Ἰακώβ Græcized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites:--James.

G2162.d: from εὔφημος; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good report.

G2166.d: of foreign origin (compare פְּרָת); Euphrates, a river of Asia:--Euphrates.

G2371.d: from a presumed compound of θυμός and μάχομαι; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.

G2284.d: from θάμβος; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.

G2154.d: from εὖ and the base of σημαίνω; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant:--easy to be understood.

G2228.d: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially ἤδη, ἤπερ, ἤτοι.

G2205.d: from ζέω; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

G2231.d: from ἡγεμών; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.

G2437.d: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe:--Illyricum.

G2028.d: from ἐπί and ὀνομάζω; to name further, i.e. denominate:--call.

G2368.d: from θυμιάω; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.

G2096.d: of Hebrew origin (חַוָּה); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman:--Eve.

G2212.d: of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare πυνθάνομαι.

G2159.d: adverb from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of (to stretch); in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely):--mightily, vehemently.

G2295.d: apparently from a form of θεάομαι; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.

G2441.d: from ἱματίζω; clothing:--apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.

G2341.d: from a compound of θηρίον and μάχομαι; to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men):--fight with wild beasts.

G2095.d: neuter of a primary (good); (adverbially) well:--good, well (done).

G2221.d: from the same as ζῶον and ἀγρεύω; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.

G2058.d: from the same as ἑρμηνεύω; translation:--interpretation.

G2376.d: from θύρα; an aperture, i.e. window:--window.

G2498.d: of Hebrew origin (יְהוֹשָׁפָט); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite:--Josaphat.

G2407.d: prolongation from ἱερεύς; to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions:--execute the priest's office.

G2161.d: from εὖ and a derivative of τυγχάνω; well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.

G2455.d: of Hebrew origin (יְהוּדָה); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region:--Juda(-h, -s); Jude.

G2197.d: of Hebrew origin (זְכַרְיָה); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites:--Zacharias.

G2163.d: from εὖ and φήμη; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.

G2146.d: from a compound of εὖ and πρόσωπον; to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display:--make a fair show.

G2281.d: probably prolonged from ἅλς; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.

G2007.d: from ἐπί and τίθημι; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):--add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.

G2415.d: from Ἱεροσόλυμα; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of Jerusalem.

G2374.d: apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.

G2489.d: feminine of the same as Ἰωάννης; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.

G2185.d: from ἐπί and a cognate of ἥκω; to arrive upon, i.e. extend to:--reach.

G2293.d: from θάρσος; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare θαῤῥέω.

G2172.d: middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to God:--pray, will, wish.

G2194.d: of Hebrew origin (זְבוּלוּן); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of Palestine:--Zabulon.

G2080.d: from εἰς; inside (as preposition or adjective):-- (with-)in(-ner, -to, -ward).

G2315.d: from θεός and a presumed derivative of πνέω; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.

G2497.d: perhaps for Ἰωράμ; Jorim, an Israelite:--Jorim.

G2313.d: from θεομάχος; to resist deity:--fight against God.

G2074.d: of Hebrew origin (חֶצְרוֹן); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom.

G2482.d: probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe:--Italy.

G2218.d: from the root of (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair of balances, yoke.

G2253.d: from a presumed compound of the base of ἥμισυ and θνήσκω; half dead, i.e. entirely exhausted:--half dead.

G2428.d: from a derivative of the base of ἱκανός (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.

G2052.d: perhaps as the same as ἐρεθίζω; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction:--contention(-ious), strife.

G2055.d: from ἔριφος; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person):--goat.

G2307.d: from the prolonged form of θέλω; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will.

G2448.d: of Hebrew origin (יְהוּדָה or perhaps יֻטָּה); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine:--Judah.

G2012.d: from ἐπί and τρόπος (in the sense of ἐπιτροπή); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.

G2282.d: probably akin to (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.

G2357.d: probably from the base of θροέω; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.

G2214.d: from ζητέω; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme:--question.

G2394.d: future active participle masculine of ἰάομαι; about to cure; Jason, a Christian:--Jason.

G2119.d: from εὔκαιρος; to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure:--have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

G2158.d: from εὖ and σχῆμα; well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank):--comely, honourable.

G2168.d: from εὐχάριστος; to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal:--(give) thank(-ful, -s).

G2300.d: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

G2101.d: from εὖ and ἀρεστός; fully agreeable:--acceptable(-ted), wellpleasing.

G2010.d: from ἐπί and the base of τροπή; to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow:--give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

G2431.d: from the same as ἵλεως; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt or willing:--cheerful.

G2336.d: from τίθημι; a receptacle, i.e. scabbard:--sheath.

G2234.d: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή; sweetly, i.e. (figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.

G2151.d: from εὐσεβής; to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support):--show piety, worship.

G2463.d: perhaps from ἐρέω (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.

G2039.d: from ἐργάτης; occupation; by implication, profit, pains:--craft, diligence, gain, work.

G2027.d: from ἐπί and (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel:--run aground.

G2299.d: feminine of θεός; a female deity:--goddess.

G2353.d: from τρέφω; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.

G2378.d: from θύω; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.

G2226.d: neuter of a derivative of ζάω; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.

G2319.d: from θεός and the base of στυγνητός; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.

G2094.d: apparently a primary word; a year:--year.

G2279.d: of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.

G2363.d: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.

G2370.d: from a derivative of θύω (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.

G2131.d: from εὖ and νίκη; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.

G2334.d: from a derivative of θεάομαι (perhaps by addition of ὁράω); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

G2488.d: of Hebrew origin (יוֹתָם); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an Israelite:--Joatham.

G2344.d: from τίθημι; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.

G2041.d: from a primary (but obsolete) (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act:--deed, doing, labour, work.

G2397.d: from εἴδω; a sight (comparative figuratively "idea"), i.e. aspect:--countenance.

G2442.d: middle voice from (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for:--be affectionately desirous.

G2453.d: from Ἰουδά (in the sense of Ἰούδας as a country); Judæan, i.e. belonging to Jehudah:--Jew(-ess), of Judæa.

G2452.d: adverb from Ἰουδαϊκός; Judaïcally or in a manner resembling a Judæan:--as do the Jews.

G2278.d: from ἦχος; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.

G2090.d: from ἕτοιμος; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare κατασκευάζω.

G2200.d: from ζέω; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively, fervent):--hot.

G2180.d: from Ἔφεσος; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus.

G2333.d: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.

G2092.d: from an old noun (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready:--prepared, (made) ready(-iness, to our hand).

G2202.d: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as ζυγός; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.

G2382.d: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.

G2380.d: a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

G2461.d: neuter of a derivative of ἵππος; the cavalry force:--horse(-men).

G2111.d: from εὖ and a derivative of τίθημι; well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate:--fit, meet.

G2274.d: from the same as ἥττον; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.

G2325.d: from θέρος (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.

G2411.d: neuter of ἱερός; a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas ναός denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere):--temple.

G2121.d: from εὖ and καιρός; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time of need.

G2011.d: from ἐπιτρέπω; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.

G2389.d: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.

G2491.d: of Hebrew origin (יוֹחָנָן); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites:--John.

G2148.d: from (the east wind) and κλύδων; a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter:--Euroklydon.

G2184.d: from ἐπί and ἡμέρα; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.

G2473.d: from ἴσος and ψυχή; of similar spirit:--likeminded.

G2351.d: from the base of θροέω; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.

G2150.d: from εὐσεβής; piety; specially, the gospel scheme:--godliness, holiness.

G2398.d: of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate:--X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

G2242.d: of Hebrew origin (עֵלִי); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.

G2256.d: from the base of ἥμισυ and ὥρα; a half-hour:--half an hour.

G2140.d: from a compound of εὖ and ποιέω; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do good.

G2209.d: probably akin to the base of δαμάζω (through the idea of violence); detriment:--damage, loss.

G2005.d: from ἐπί and τελέω; to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo:--accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).

G2350.d: from θόρυβος; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

G2445.d: of Hebrew origin (יָפוֹ); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine:--Joppa.

G2310.d: from a derivative of τίθημι; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.

G2078.d: a superlative probably from ἔχω (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time):--ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.

G2343.d: from θησαυρός; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

G2322.d: from θεραπεύω; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.

G2191.d: of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively):--viper.

G2177.d: from ἐπί and ἅλλομαι; to spring upon:--leap on.

G2029.d: from ἐπί and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.

G2217.d: akin to the base of νέφος; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.

G2289.d: from θάνατος to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.
r: cause to be put to death

G2372.d: from θύω; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare ψυχή.

G2235.d: apparently from ἤ (or possibly ἦ) and δή; even now:--already, (even) now (already), by this time.

G2260.d: from ἤ and περ; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.

G2132.d: from a compound of εὖ and νοῦς; to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile:--agree.

G2318.d: from θεός and σέβομαι; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.

G2309.d: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι; to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas βούλομαι properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in:--desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).

G2134.d: from εὐνοῦχος; to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried):--make…eunuch.

G2405.d: from ἱερατεύω; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the priesthood, priest's office.

G2062.d: neuter of a derivative of (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare רֶמֶשׂ)) a small animal:--creeping thing, serpent.

G2469.d: of Hebrew origin (probably אִישׁ and קִרְיָא); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor:--Iscariot.

G2328.d: from θέρμη; to heat (oneself):--(be) warm(-ed, self).

G2173.d: from εὖ and χρηστός; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for use.

G2269.d: of Hebrew origin (עֵשָׂו); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.

G2298.d: from θαυμάζω; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).

G2359.d: genitive case , etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare κόμη.

G2129.d: from the same as εὐλογέω; fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess:--blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

G2273.d: from ἤ and τοί; either indeed:--whether.

G2339.d: from (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.

G2215.d: of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.

G2046.d: probably a fuller form of ῥέω; an alternate for ἔπω in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell.

G2276.d: neuter of comparative of (slightly) used for that of κακός; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.

G2211.d: probably contracted from a poetic form of Ζεύς and δῶρον; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.

G2261.d: probably from ἔπος; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.

G2018.d: from ἐπί and φέρω; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:--add, bring (against), take.
